name: AIChief

sources.title: Submit Your AI Tool — pricing tiers ($0 Free / $99 Verified / $149 Featured / Gold $200+), submission rules, FAQ

requirements: Only AI tools accepted — the product must have AI features
No beta or waitlist tools ('we are not entertaining submissions for Beta or Waitlist AI tools right now')
No NSFW/adult tools — directory is explicitly brand-safe
Functional, publicly accessible product that a human reviewer can test hands-on
Original description required — copied content is deprioritized or rejected
Product purpose must be understandable within ~5 seconds of reading the description
preparation: Tool name, URL, and an original plain-language description
Category pick from their ~600 category tree
Paid tiers add: company website link, social links, pricing info, media gallery, pros & cons, FAQs
Account/contact email for the verification email and support channel (support@aichief.com)
workflow: Pick a tier — Free Listing $0 enters the standard manual review queue; $99 Verified and $149 Featured get priority 24-hour review plus badges and richer listing fields
Fill in tool URL and details (~5 min per the site's own estimate)
Editorial team reviews hands-on (quality, brand safety, originality)
On approval the listing goes live permanently; verification email is sent after submission
watchFor: Site 403-blocks non-Googlebot user agents — normal browser fetches may fail; a real browser session should still work
Heavy upsell surface: paid tiers, a la carte 'build your own' mix, Gold badge at $200+, campaigns — the free path is real but surrounded by upsells
Free tier only includes 'Basic Tool Information' — media gallery, social links, pricing info are paid-only fields
Free submissions have no stated turnaround; 24-hour review applies to paid priority
Updates to paid listings take 2-3 business days via an update form
countsAsLive: The tool has a public page on aichief.com under its chosen category, reachable from site search/category browse, showing the listing tier's fields
unknowns: Free-tier review turnaround (only paid 24h is stated)
Exact free-form fields — the embedded form did not render in fetched text
